title: Show HN: Lofi Cities – Pixel-art city nights with browser-generated lofi
summary: Lofi Cities is a browser-based web app that generates pixel-art city night scenes paired with procedurally generated lofi music, all running client-side without server dependencies. It was shared on Hacker News as a Show HN project, drawing significant community interest with 300 points and 120 comments discussing its implementation and creative approach.
